newsitem.title: USA: Maritrans 5.12 pct stake held by investor.
newsitem.headline: Maritrans 5.12 pct stake held by investor.

text.p: I. Wistar Morris III, a Conshohocken, Pa-investment adviser, said Tuesday he controls a 5.12 percent stake or 612,800 common shares in Maritrans Inc.
In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, Morris said his group most recently acquired 1,400 shares of Maritrans on May 23 at $6.625 each.
Maritrans, with headquarters in Philadelphia, provides water transportation services and storage to major oil companies, petroleum distributers and major consumers.
Morris said the shares are held for investment purposes only.
